05 / Looking back, moving forward

Reflection

“Every lesson gives me a chance to understand more, improve myself, and become more prepared for the future.”

MY PERSONAL LEARNING REFLECTION

My journey as a HUMSS student teaches me that learning also means being open-minded, responsible, and willing to grow. Some activities challenge me to speak up, work with others, or look at an issue from a different perspective. These experiences remind me that improvement takes patience and effort.

I am proud of the progress I make, even when it comes through small steps. Moving forward, I want to become more confident in expressing my ideas, more careful in understanding information, and more compassionate toward other people. I will use every challenge as an opportunity to learn.
